text: ok and then for the wall from the pieces, does it sit on the edge of the floor or on top of the floor
resolution: Answered the wall-vs-floor placement question by checking the game oracle and hmsc-int build snap/placement source. Confirmed walls are edge-snapped in x/z to the floor/roof perimeter, while their base y is anchored to the top of that floor/roof plate, so the wall stands on the floor top edge rather than on a side face or floating on the floor center. No files changed.
